entry.name: Riolu-H
entry.flavor: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.
entry.flavorEs: Percibe los sentimientos de quienes lo rodean, así como las condiciones del entorno, mediante unas ondas conocidas como auras.
entry.flavorZh: 除了能读懂对手的感情， 也能以“波导”这种形式的波 来观察大自然的样子。

abilities.textEn: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
abilities.textEs: Cada vez que se amedrenta sube su Velocidad, debido a su voluntad inquebrantable.
abilities.detail: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
abilities.detailEs: Cada vez que este Pokémon se amedrenta, su Velocidad sube un nivel.
abilities.detailZh: 每当该宝可梦畏缩时，其速度提高1级。
abilities.detailPt: Sempre que este Pokémon hesita, sua Velocidade sobe um estágio.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.textEs: Gracias a su profunda concentración, no se amedrenta ante los ataques del rival.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon's Status moves have priority raised by 1, but Dark types are immune.
abilities.textEs: Sus movimientos de estado tienen prioridad alta.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.
abilities.detailEs: Los movimientos que no causan daño de este Pokémon tienen su prioridad aumentada en un nivel.
abilities.detailZh: 该宝可梦的非伤害招式的先制度提高1级。
abilities.detailPt: Os movimentos deste Pokémon que não causam dano têm sua prioridade aumentada em um estágio.
